Leah Ortiz (AE): Sharing PO + ask: need legal sign-off on MSA and confirmation of who signs the order form. Attached: PO_7842.pdf
Ravi Sharma (Solutions): Quick summary: POC successful. Customer wants Redwood Dedicated, needs BYOK and stricter audit logs.
Jake (SalesOps): Finance question: do we require vendor W-9 and exact PO# mapping for e-invoicing? Please confirm.
Camille Park (Legal): I'll take the MSA/DPA redlines. Do they propose any new indemnity or data processing terms? Upload redline doc if possible.
Leah Ortiz (AE): They added a paragraph limiting liability for model outputs and lowered SLA to 99.5%. Uploaded redline: Acquis_MSA_redline_v2.docx
Ravi Sharma (Solutions): They specifically call out HSM-backed key custody and per-tenant audit trails. That will be a Private deployment request.
miles-infra: We support customer-managed keys for Private but HSM custody needs a signed addendum and Ops runbook. Can produce runbook in 48 hours.
docusign-bot: :white_check_mark: PO_7842.pdf uploaded. Please confirm Redwood signer and customer signer emails for envelope routing.
Leah Ortiz (AE): Customer signer emails: procurement@acquisition.io (PO), legal@acquisition.io (MSA), ceo_sign@acquisition.io (exec). Finance copy: ap@acquisition.io
Camille Park (Legal): Exec signatories need proof of authority. Also, if SLA is 99.5%, Legal needs pricing offset or time-limited exception.
Jake (SalesOps): Finance: if we accept 99.5%, we need an SLA credit table on the order form and the PO must include PO# and billing contact.
Leah Ortiz (AE): Customer is open to a one-time KMS onboarding fee to cover extra infra work. Can we add that?
Jake (SalesOps): Recommend: "KMS Onboarding (one-time) - $6,000". I'll prepare billing line item.
Camille Park (Legal): I'll prepare a short addendum: 6-month SLA exception to 99.5% with credit schedule + KMS onboarding fee line + exec signatory delegation clause. Will comment in redline doc.
Ravi Sharma (Solutions): Please add Appendix A to the OF containing the KMS onboarding test plan and audit log schema so Security can sign off.
Leah Ortiz (AE): Confirming signers again: procurement@acquisition.io, legal@acquisition.io, ceo_sign@acquisition.io. AP copy -> ap@acquisition.io
Camille Park (Legal): Target: post redline comments by EOD. If no material new blockers, route for exec signature tomorrow.
Jake (SalesOps): Once Camille posts, I'll assemble DocuSign envelope: Redwood legal -> legal@redwood.ai, Customer exec -> ceo_sign@acquisition.io, PO copy -> ap@acquisition.io.
Leah Ortiz (AE): :thumbsup: I'll ping when customer's procurement confirms routing. Expecting close this week if everything aligns.
